map.气体类别 IIA/IIB/IIC 怎么选？: How Do I Choose Between IIA/IIB/IIC?
map.按环境中存在气体的最大试验安全间隙 MESG 定：丙烷等 MESG>0.9mm: Set by the MESG of the gas present: propane and similar with MESG > 0.9 mm are IIA, ethylene and similar at 0.5–0.9 mm are IIB, and hydrogen, acetylene, and similar at ≤0.5 mm are IIC. IIC covers IIB and IIA and offers the highest protection level, so choosing wrong severely understates the explosion risk.
map.温度组别 T 和数字什么关系？: What Does the Number in the T Class Mean?
map.T 后面数字越大允许表面温度越低：T1=450℃、T2=300℃、T3=200℃: The larger the number after T, the lower the permitted surface temperature: T1 = 450 °C, T2 = 300 °C, T3 = 200 °C, T4 = 135 °C, T5 = 100 °C, T6 = 85 °C; it must stay below the ignition temperature of the surrounding gas, or a hot surface can become an ignition source.
